nodes.speaker: hq
nodes.text: The window is open! The ascent vehicle's tanks are filling with fuel made from Mars's own air.

variants.text: The window is open! Our honest reports earned Earth's trust, so the launch plan is yours to decide.
The window is open! The ascent vehicle is ready, though our patched ship made Earth nervous. The plan is yours.

nodes.fact: Mars's air is about 95% carbon dioxide. NASA's MOXIE experiment on Perseverance made breathable oxygen from it.
